label: Первый – Пятый
description: A 10-sentence card for ordinal numerals first through fifth.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative. 'Первый' is an ordinal numeral that declines like an adjective and agrees with masculine 'день' in gender, number and case, here nominative singular.
Strategic focus: Masculine prepositional. 'Втором' agrees with 'этаже' in the prepositional case after 'на', taking the hard adjective ending -ом for masculine ordinals.
Strategic focus: Soft-stem ordinal. 'Третий' is unique among ordinals with soft endings; in the masculine prepositional it becomes 'третьем' with a soft -ьем, agreeing with 'ряду'.
Strategic focus: Feminine soft ordinal. The soft-stem 'третий' takes the feminine ending -ья, giving 'третья', which agrees with feminine 'дверь' in the nominative.
Strategic focus: Neuter soft ordinal. 'Третий' takes the neuter soft ending -ье to form 'третье', agreeing with neuter 'окно' in the nominative singular.
Strategic focus: Feminine prepositional. 'Четвёртой' agrees with feminine 'неделе' in the prepositional after 'на', using the feminine ending -ой; note the ё in the stem.
Strategic focus: Feminine accusative. 'Вторую' agrees with feminine 'главу' in the accusative singular, taking the adjectival ending -ую as a direct object.
Strategic focus: Masculine nominative. 'Пятый' agrees with masculine 'автобус' in the nominative singular, declining like a hard-stem adjective.
Strategic focus: Soft-stem genitive. The soft ordinal 'третий' takes the masculine genitive -ьего after the preposition 'без', giving 'третьего', agreeing with 'звонка'.
Strategic focus: Masculine instrumental. 'Первым' agrees with masculine 'столом' in the instrumental after 'за', using the adjectival ending -ым.
